gen-fs-quilon-gf-lexend-zetta: Approachable and widely tracked, Lexend Zetta cuts its strokes like ribbon of constant width. And Quilon, with bowls that swell only slightly, does its best work up in the headline.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-michroma: Contemporary and wide-set, Michroma gives each letter a generous berth on both sides. And Quilon shifts its stroke weight noticeably but never dramatically, a slow tide against that low-contrast body.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Quilon is at its best making an editorial statement, thin strokes of respectable weight. And Mochiy Pop One is at its best being plain about it, with very large lowercase and no tapering.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Slow swells, no snap: Quilon changes weight gradually, with large open counters in a, e and s. And Mochiy Pop P One keeps strokes constant with wide gaps between letters, a steady sans-serif counterweight to that gradual heading.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-montserrat-underline: Commanding, Quilon rolls through a faint thick-thin rhythm, like crayon on rough paper. The standout quality is how Montserrat Underline draws fine, rope-like strokes in round bowls that never swell or taper.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads approachably, its big-bodied lowercase ending in a splayed c terminal. Page after page it should feel easygoing and modern, while Quilon adds quiet stroke modulation and an editorial edge to the headings.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-mozilla-text: Professional and sturdy, Mozilla Text flares its terminals outward. Quilon leads with restrained thick-thin shading in every glyph, and that quiet modulation lets the flared body type carry its weight.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-nobile: A slow ebb and flow of stroke thickness defines Quilon. Nobile joins in with open-mouthed letters and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase, so the two share a page easily.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-nokora: Clean and approachable, Nokora lays a wide-open s and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Quilon belongs up top, its weight shifting gently from stem to serif.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Quilon tapers modestly, with large open counters in a, e and s, and an editorial air. Noto Kufi Arabic keeps the sans-serif text modern and clean, with an open gap in the c that makes paragraphs flow.
